benchmark_run: MiniWoB++ (miniwob==1.1.0), 12 seeded tasks x 3 episodes, text-DOM agent
substitute_gap: MiniWoB++ is synthetic single-widget web tasks in a 160x210px sandbox, far easier and narrower than WebBench's real-website read/write/update tasks, so this number says nothing about WebBench-level capability.
actor: pavlov-public-portfolio-bf16 @ https://arvindcr4--pavlov-trained-actor-e1e14-serve.modal.run (Modal vLLM, raw /v1/completions, same chat-templated token ids)
caveats: Tasks drawn by random.Random(20260926).sample from all 128 sorted miniwob env ids; episode seeds 0-2.
Action set: CLICK(ref), TYPE(ref,text), CLICK_XY, KEY; no drag or select-option primitive, so drag-box/draw-line/choose-list are effectively unsolvable for this agent (0/9).
Max 10 steps/episode, single-line action per step, DOM text truncated to 150 elements; no retries.
Not comparable to the 2026-09-20 qwen3:8b 6/6 proxy (different model, tasks, harness).
Paired vLLM arm: identical items, prompts (chat template, enable_thinking=False), temperature 0, max_tokens, harness and grader as the Tinker-base run; only endpoint/model id changed.
modal_usd not attributed per lane (shared GPU bill reconciled by lead).

First vLLM attempt of both arms (started 14:46Z) was aborted: host disk filled (ENOSPC) and Selenium read-timeouts hit 2 trained / 1 base episodes, base crashed. Both arms rerun cleanly from scratch; aborted data kept in raw/aborted_run1_disk_full/, not scored.
vllm_tokens = prompt+completion tokens logged by the shim (raw/shim_usage.jsonl).
